Data  ·  Rate-Filing Roll-Up  ·  Updated September 16, 2026

2026 auto & home insurance rate filings, by state & carrier

A primary-source roll-up of approved state rate filings — who raised, who cut, by how much, with a link to every source.

BoringRate Editorial  ·  sourced from state DOI filings

Every approved 2026 auto and homeowners insurance rate filing we’ve collected, by state and carrier — 262 increases, 187 decreases across 15 states and 131 carriers. Each row links to its primary source: the state Department of Insurance filing (by SERFF tracking number) or open-data portal it came from. Filter by product, state, or direction and search any carrier; click any column to sort by rate change, effective date, or national market share.

For journalists & researchers: figures are filed/approved statewide-average rate changes from state insurance regulators. Sources are the SERFF Filing Access system (session-bound — cited by tracking number), Texas TDI open data (data.texas.gov), and the California CDI filings list. Please cite as “BoringRate, 2026 rate-filing roll-up, September 2026.”
